harmonic_radius_epsilon_lemma_skeleton.lemma_name: C0-Ricci pinching annular epsilon regularity in harmonic radius
harmonic_radius_epsilon_lemma_skeleton.intended_statement: In dimension 4, on a noncollapsed annulus with |Ric-g|<=delta_i->0 (or rescaled |Ric|<=epsilon_i) and sufficiently small scale-invariant L2 curvature energy on a buffered annulus, the harmonic radius on the middle annulus has a uniform lower bound at the annulus scale.
harmonic_radius_epsilon_lemma_skeleton.why_CZ_spike_not_counterexample: Step 11's opposite-warping spike makes pointwise |Rm| large at exponentially tiny scale but has C^{1,alpha} harmonic-coordinate size tending to zero for fixed alpha<1; it refutes curvature epsilon-regularity, not harmonic-radius convergence.
harmonic_radius_epsilon_lemma_skeleton.use_in_Route_A: Combines with CGB L2 budget and energy quantization (EH quantum 12*pi^2 for A1) to isolate finite bubbles and rule out L2 energy on intermediate neck scales; the balanced annulus r=t^(2/3) should then admit the finite indicial expansion needed for the H2/H4 Wronskian comparison.
harmonic_radius_epsilon_lemma_skeleton.failure_value: A counterexample would expose a new Ricci-pinched, noncollapsed, small-L2-energy annular degeneration invisible to standard curvature regularity; that would materially redirect Yau26.
